_status: UNPOPULATED. Maps OCG tool output fields to PUBLIC COREP template/row references, same as exporters/taxonomies/eba-corep-concept-map.json (§13.8, XBRL 2.1 XML wire format) — this file is the xBRL-CSV (DPM 2.0) sibling. The machine-readable DPM 2.0 metric qnames (eba_met), dimensional members, entry-point schemaRefs, and exact table/row/col coordinates MUST be populated from the published EBA RF 4.0 DPM 2.0 taxonomy package before this is used to emit a submission-shaped report. DO NOT FABRICATE eba_met qnames (OCG Standard §13.14 / §13.8 / core project rule). Until eba_qname is populated, a build against these taxonomies MUST return a 'pending' error and the ocg-ext table template is used instead — see fixtures/xbrl-csv/annex2-eba-dpm-corep.pending.json for the minimal fixture the §15 gate reads.
